selectors: nearest Unity project root from CWD

publicRoot.requestId: one UUID per direct public call
publicRoot.targetPool: one independent pool per live Editor or Development Player session
publicRoot.unifiedCatalog: one slot in every online target session whose catalog contributes to the public result
publicRoot.internalChildren: catalog resolution, readiness, start, status, terminal, rebind and completion readback reuse the same root and never acquire another slot

admission.exactObservationRule: only these exact frozen local definitions execute without business admission acquire/revoke and without the ordinary strict instance selector; names, aliases, groups, handlers and arbitrary offline Tools cannot inherit the exclusion
admission.polling: one acquire at a time; each denied response sleeps an independent integer in [80,120] milliseconds

request.serialization: one immutable UTF-8 body without BOM, frozen only after admission
request.executionDeadline: executionDeadline = finalGrantObservedAt + the full normalized --timeout-ms T; it is created once
request.redelivery: within one direct call, exact bytes may be redelivered only while editorSessionId is unchanged; after the first mutation POST a new Editor session forbids another POST

toolExecution.success: terminal business success proven by the tool's unique completion contract
toolExecution.failure: terminal structured failure with stable code, details and nextActions

ordinary.completion: one complete snapshot from one validated listener generation
ordinary.transitionPolicy: wait within the execution deadline, then rerun the complete read

editor.state.completion: one immediate read-only registry, Bridge and Windows observation in the exact admission-independent observation lane
editor.state.privateBridgeCommand: internal.editor.state.snapshot only; mutation=false; target=editor; rootAdmission absent

operability.registry: v3 atomic lifecycle publication for discovery and generation handoff
operability.health: v3 strict transport identity plus read-only in-memory main-thread pulse
operability.domainReload: registry lifecycle, new listener generation, then the first main-thread pulse for that generation; no fixed-duration marker

failClosed: Editor session replacement after mutation POST

directCall.terminal: each direct call returns a proven terminal business result or terminal structured failure
directCall.oneDeadline: selectors, Bridge requests, Windows observations and blocker enrichment consume the applicable existing absolute deadline; blocker diagnosis may shorten it to 10 seconds but never creates another budget
directCall.localTimeoutOwnership: run is invoked once; every settlement gets one cleanup continuation for still-unconsumed local leases, and when the public deadline wins its E_EXECUTION_TIMEOUT envelope is immutable and the first local effect barrier closes
directCall.localProcessExit: pending local cleanup shares the single 1000ms stdout flush grace; a never-settling Promise cannot add another timer or keep the CLI alive beyond it
directCall.admissionBusy: E_UNITY_BUSY before business POST proves no effect started and permits a later new root
directCall.timeout: after grant or POST, timeout, disconnect or cross-session mutation fence returns E_EXECUTION_TIMEOUT with unknown outcome; observe business state before a new submission decision
directCall.replay: same-session exact terminal recovery may return an existing terminal without a new slot; cross-session mutation redelivery is forbidden
directCall.slotRelease: unconsumed grants expire or are revoked; consumed roots are released only by the Unity terminal owner or exact cleanup; completeRootAdmission cleanup is separately bounded and cannot rewrite the public terminal
directCall.audit: business audit is a session-level append log; admission probes never enter it

host.reason: admission may consume T and execution receives a fresh T
host.earlyExit: host timeout does not prove the CLI, grant or Unity effect stopped

compile.proof: owned CompilationPipeline cycle terminal, zero compiler errors, import/compile/reload stable and Editor ready
